# Refine

> > Refine is an open-source React framework for building enterprise-grade admin panels, internal tools, and CRUD applications with headless architecture and extensive UI library integrations.

Refine provides developers with a comprehensive ecosystem for rapidly building data-intensive applications. The platform offers templates, tutorials, and integrations with popular UI libraries like Material UI, Chakra UI, and Ant Design, while supporting modern development practices including TypeScript, REST APIs, and cloud-native technologies like Kubernetes.

## Key Topics

- Refine Core
- React framework
- Admin panels and internal tools
- CRUD applications
- Material UI integration
- Headless architecture
- Data fetching and state management
- UI component libraries
- Ant Design
- Chakra UI
- Notification providers
- TypeScript support
- REST API integration
- Kubernetes deployment
- No-code dashboard builder

- [Generic Internal Tool Template with Chakra UI](https://refine.dev/core/templates/chakra-ui-template): Chakra UI template for internal tools and admin panels with Vite
- [How to Turn a CSV Into a Working Dashboard For Free (Without Writing Code)](https://refine.dev/blog/csv-to-dashboard-no-code): No-code CSV to React dashboard conversion using Refine builder
